summary: Iter154 · Phase F · UNIFIED SIGNATURE ENGINE — full backend + frontend testing complete. 12/12 backend pytest cases pass: capture (with image), refusal valid/invalid, validation (bad source_module/signature_type, oversize image), supersedes chain (append-only with superseded_by/superseded_at + default-list excludes superseded, include_superseded=true returns both), GET filter ordering (most-recent-first) + signer_employee_id filter, and 401 auth gate for both POST and GET. Frontend on /safety-portal/corrective-actions: edit dialog renders [safety-ca-sig-capture] with all 5 sub-testids (name-input, canvas, clear, refusal-toggle, submit), validations fire correct toasts ('Signer name is required' / 'sign the pad or refuse'), mouse-stroke signature capture transitions to [safety-ca-sig-captured] block showing signer name + timestamp + base64 image thumbnail with toast 'Signature captured', refusal flow shows [safety-ca-sig-refusal-block] amber callout, records refusal with reason and toast 'Refusal recorded'. Zero console errors during sign + refusal flows. Mobile 375x812: canvas touch-action:none confirmed, refusal toggle visible without horizontal overflow on the signature component itself.

design_issues.screen: Safety CA edit dialog on mobile 375x812
issues: documentElement.scrollWidth > window.innerWidth detected (horizontal overflow). The SignatureCapture component itself renders within the viewport cleanly per screenshot; overflow likely comes from a parent (DialogContent or another row in the CA form). Worth a quick audit but does not affect signature usability.

action_items: (Optional) Audit Safety CA edit Dialog mobile width — minor horizontal overflow at 375px detected (signature card itself is fine; likely another row in dialog).
critical_code_review_comments: signature_service.capture() is clean and audit-safe: append-only, supersedes chain marks prior row with superseded_by + superseded_at (no silent overwrites). Solid foundation for Phase I asset-transfer receiver signatures.
ALLOWED_MODULES whitelist (21 modules) + Pydantic field_validator gives strong 422 enforcement — observed working.
Image guard fires correctly: Pydantic max_length=2_000_000 hits first (returns 422); service-layer 1.8MB runtime check is a defensible second line.
Routes correctly exclude MongoDB _id via projection {_id: 0} on GET and explicit doc.pop('_id') on POST — no ObjectId leak.

SignatureCapture.jsx: canvas DPR scaling on mount only — if the dialog opens before the canvas has measurable size or is conditionally remounted, bounding rect may be 0; current Safety CA dialog renders OK but worth keeping a ResizeObserver-style guard in mind for portals that mount it inside collapsing accordions.
Component correctly uses touch-action:none and supports both mouse and touch handlers — touch test on mobile would be valuable in a future iteration.
